knownDefects.scope: 191 product and gate tests, reproducible static build, static asset/external-URL audit, dependency audit, Chrome campaign/browser checks, deterministic visual/audio/difficulty audits, and the five-minute loaded soak
knownDefects.statement: No reproducible product defect remains open inside the observed Phase 09 scope. Missing environment or subjective evidence is tracked as residual risk, not converted into a defect or a pass.

qualityTargets.summary: 1 of 6 required targets passed; 0 real mobile targets passed.
Fun, feel, legibility, beauty, nostalgia, novelty, and listening quality were not inferred from machine evidence.

residualRisks.summary: Edge, Firefox, Safari, iOS Safari real-device, and Android Chrome real-device coverage is missing.
No physical low-end target device has been measured; the four-render-pass workload is not a device substitute.
The browser compatibility pass predates the current performance-soak build ID, so the final release candidate must be revalidated as one immutable build.
Human subjective quality is unmeasured by explicit project policy and is not a progression gate.
Generated-image non-uniqueness and non-infringement are not guaranteed; rights terms and shipped notices require Phase 10 recheck.

gateDecision.reason: Phase 09 measurements and risk recording are complete with zero critical or major known defects in scope. Phase 10 must close every acceptance blocker and revalidate one release-candidate build before final acceptance.
